prompt: Create a full-body stylized digital character illustration of a tall athletic male footballer resembling Cristiano Ronaldo, standing in a confident fashion-pose on a plain light gray-white background. Use a painterly concept-art style with sharp angular brushwork, exaggerated heroic proportions, long muscular legs, broad shoulders, narrow waist, and a stern focused facial expression. He has short dark cropped hair, tan skin, strong cheekbones, and looks slightly downward with a serious attitude. Outfit: an oversized red Manchester United-inspired football jersey with a dark diagonal shoulder stripe, white pointed collar detail, small crest on the left chest, and loose rolled sleeves; the shirt is lifted high to reveal the abdomen and midriff. Add black football shorts with red side stripes and a large white number 7 on the front right leg. Pose: one hand planted on the hip, the other arm hanging down, torso leaning slightly back, legs long and asymmetrical with one knee relaxed. Footwear: mismatched football boots, one bright red boot and one black boot, with black socks and loose shin-guard-like folds around the ankles. Lighting should be soft studio lighting with minimal shadow, muted colors, high-contrast dark red and black sportswear, no crowd, no field, no text, no watermark, no extra characters. Preserve the rough fashion-concept sketch feel rather than photorealism.

promptZh: 创作一张全身风格化的数字角色插图，描绘一名高大健壮的男性足球运动员，外形类似于 Cristiano Ronaldo，以自信的时尚姿势站在纯浅灰白色的背景上。采用油画概念艺术风格，运用锐利的棱角笔触、夸张的英雄比例、修长的双腿、宽阔的肩膀、窄腰以及严肃专注的面部表情。他留着短发，肤色黝黑，颧骨突出，神情严肃，目光略微向下。服装：一件超大号的曼联风格红色足球球衣，带有深色斜向肩带、白色尖领细节、左胸前有小徽章，袖口宽松卷起；球衣向上撩起，露出腹部和腰部。黑色足球短裤，侧面有红色条纹，右腿前侧印有巨大的白色数字 7。姿势：一只手叉腰，另一只手臂下垂，躯干微微后倾，双腿修长且不对称，一只膝盖放松。鞋类：鸳鸯足球鞋，一只为亮 red 色，另一只为 black 色，搭配黑色球袜，脚踝处有类似护腿板的松散褶皱。光照应为柔和的摄影棚灯光，阴影极少，色彩柔和，采用高对比度的深红色和黑色运动装，无观众，无球场，无文字，无水印，无额外角色。保持粗犷的时尚概念草图质感，而非写实风格。
